name: Deep Lantern texture pack
source_of_truth: GDD Parts 1-10 (visual references are style only; no gameplay values come from images)

maps.emissive.png: optional; apply as Neon/emissive overlay or SurfaceAppearance.EmissiveMaskContent

materials.roblox: Upload color/normal/roughness/metalness as Images, then use SurfaceAppearance on a MeshPart. For plain Parts use color.png on a Texture (StudsPerTileU/V = studs_per_tile).

conventions.ui_panels: 9-slice. ImageLabel.ScaleType = Slice, SliceCenter from manifest (px in source). Chamfer is baked in, do not add UICorner.
conventions.vfx: Particles: ParticleEmitter.Texture. Beams: Beam.Texture. Respect GDD budgets (<=150 particles Low).

moss.notes: Moss overlay for rocks and ruins

ruins_blocks.notes: Ancient masonry for Kelp ruins and Lost Ruins teaser

hud/vignette_navy.png.usage: Depth transition screen-edge tint (fullscreen, ZIndex under HUD).

hud/vignette_alert.png.usage: Critical Hull/Battery warning edge (no white flash, no strobe; fade slowly <=1Hz).

hud/sonar_sweep.png.usage: Rotate this ImageLabel (Rotation) for the sonar sweep; event-driven pings preferred (no per-frame polling).

hud/recall_ring.png.usage: Emergency Recall light-ring presentation (rotate + scale; with cavitation bubbles).

hud/bio_pulse.png.usage: Bioluminescent pulse (tint per creature). Animate ImageTransparency, not per-frame logic.
